snippet.title: DevLog#3: Spring - Cosy Game in Unreal Engine 5 (New Sprig character!)
snippet.description:
In this episode, I’m showing off the new character design, a bunch of new level elements, and a full rewrite of the animals system using AI and Data Assets in Unreal Engine.

This update is a big step forward for the project, both visually and technically. The new character helps define the game’s style much better, while the new environment pieces make the world feel more alive and cohesive. On the systems side, I’ve been rebuilding how animals work so they’re easier to expand and manage as development continues.

In this devlog:

- New main character design
- More level/environment elements
- Rewritten animals system
- AI behavior improvements
- Data Asset based workflow in Unreal Engine

I’m excited with how the game is starting to come together, and there’s still a lot more to show in future updates.
